abstract: Does opening a market to foreign investors always benefit domestic firms? China’s 2024 healthcare FDI liberalization offers a rare opportunity to find out. Using a machine-learning distress model and difference-in-differences evidence from 169 listed healthcare firms, we show that liberalization does not uniformly reduce financial risk. Pharmaceutical firms experienced significantly elevated financial vulnerability relative to medical services firms in the immediate post-reform period—consistent with transitional competitive pressures from anticipated foreign entry. Information asymmetry, measured through a novel insider-trading proxy adapted to China’s institutional setting, remains a persistent risk driver that liberalization did not attenuate in the short run. These findings carry a direct warning: policymakers who open markets without complementary disclosure reforms risk concentrating transitional costs on the most exposed incumbent firms. Transparency gaps require dedicated regulatory attention—market opening alone cannot resolve them.

abstract: Using high-frequency administrative data from Italy, this study examines how workplace fatalities and related media and public attention affect safety outcomes. Our empirical strategy combines event-study and difference-in-differences designs with variation in newspaper circulation, article-level reporting, and exogenous shifts in public attention from unexpected football results. We find that “newsworthy” deaths—those involving young, female, or foreign-born workers—reduce non-fatal injuries, especially where media exposure and coverage are higher, but the effect weakens when attention is diverted by competing football events. These results highlight media salience, shaped by public attention, as an informal mechanism for improving workplace safety.
title: Newsworthy workplace deaths
title_zh: 有新闻价值的工作场所死亡事件

abstract: Mountain agriculture is characterised by marked structural diversity, yet comparatively less attention has been devoted to understanding how this heterogeneity is spatially organised across territories. While previous studies have mainly examined farm structural characteristics at the individual holding level, their territorial organisation has received comparatively less attention in the literature. This study investigates the spatial organisation of farm structural heterogeneity among beneficiaries of Measure 13 (M13) in the Molise Region (Italy), using total farm area and land fragmentation as complementary indicators of farm structure. Starting from parcel-level administrative and geographical information, farm centroids were reconstructed and combined with structural indicators to analyse local spatial association through Local Moran's I statistics. The results reveal clear spatial clustering for both farm size and land fragmentation, identifying distinct territorial configurations characterised by relatively large and consolidated farms as well as areas dominated by small and fragmented holdings. These findings demonstrate that structural characteristics are not randomly distributed but exhibit well-defined territorial patterns that cannot be fully captured through conventional farm-level analyses. The proposed approach provides a territorial perspective for interpreting structural heterogeneity in mountain agriculture and offers a methodological framework that may be applied to the analysis of agricultural structures in other geographical contexts. The results also provide useful evidence for the design of place-sensitive rural development policies capable of addressing the diversity of structural conditions within disadvantaged mountain areas.
title: Structural heterogeneity and spatial clustering in mountain agriculture: Evidence from European compensatory payments in the Central-Southern Apennines (Italy)
title_zh: 山地农业的结构异质性与空间集聚：来自意大利中南部亚平宁山脉欧洲补偿性支付的经验证据

abstract: Trade barriers can affect firms’ international investment decisions, not only the trade flows they directly target. This paper studies the anti-dumping and countervailing duties (AD-CVDs) imposed by the United States in 2012 on Chinese solar panel imports and examines how affected Chinese firms adjusted their foreign direct investment decisions. Due to their differential exposure to U.S. trade policy, Chinese firms are granted different AD-CVD rates. I leverage this variation to develop a difference-in-differences design. Using monthly greenfield FDI announcement data from 2009 to 2018 and a Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood estimator, I find that targeted firms increased FDI by 145 million dollars in 2012, relative to a pre-policy average of 9 million dollars. The effects are larger and more persistent among firms already active in FDI before the policy. The greenfield FDI response does not carry over to cross-border mergers and acquisitions. Location choice analysis suggests that targeted firms shifted investment toward Asia, especially after a second round of AD-CVD measures in 2015. Descriptive trade and investment data provide suggestive evidence consistent with production relocation and export-platform FDI. These results document FDI diversion that modifies investment patterns in the short run and is consistent with trade-barrier avoidance in the medium run.

abstract: With regional warming across the Arabian Peninsula occurring at twice the global average and driving summer peak electricity loads to nearly 80% of total system capacity, understanding long-term energy implications is critical for Saudi Arabia's national climate resilience. Consequently, this study assesses the impacts of climate change on thermal comfort, energy demand, and household electricity expenditure through 2100. Using the multi-sectoral Global Change Assessment Model for the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (GCAM-KSA), we integrated three regionally updated Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSP1–3) with two climate pathways: RCP7.0 (high impact) and RCP2.6 (low impact). Our results indicate a shift in thermal conditions by 2100 relative to the 1981–2014 baseline. Cooling Degree Days (CDD) are projected to increase up to 28% and 85% under the low and high-impact pathways, respectively, while Heating Degree Days (HDD) remain negligible. Furthermore, the temporal distribution of CDD expands significantly, representing a substantial lengthening of the summer season beyond mid-century. By isolating socioeconomic and climate drivers, we find that high socioeconomic development (SSP3) initially drives a 33–53% rise in cooling demand through 2060 compared to 2025. However, climate impacts emerge as the dominant accelerator between 2060 and 2100, independently driving cooling service demand up by an additional 38–49% (RCP7.0) and 13–16% (RCP2.6). Consequently, annual average household expenditures attributable to climate impacts are projected to increase by 32–45% (RCP7.0) and 7–11% (RCP2.6) in 2100. These findings highlight the importance of integrating climate adaptation strategies into long-term energy planning to mitigate rising household expenditure.
title: Long-term impacts of climate change on electricity demand and household expenditure in Saudi Arabia
title_zh: 气候变化对沙特阿拉伯电力需求和家庭支出的长期影响

abstract: Identifying the financial linkages associated with climate risk is crucial for preventing systemic risk. Based on annual reports of listed firms, this paper constructs physical and transition climate risk indices reflecting firms' attention and disclosure of climate risks, and characterizes their interdependencies with cross-industry financial risks. We adopt complex network analysis to map risk-linkage networks and measure industry resilience, apply econometric models to examine linkage characteristics, and use Random Forest (RF), XGBoost and CatBoost to predict systemic risk contagion. The results indicate that brown industries feature stronger index-financial risk associations than green industries. Physical risk linkages are short-term, whereas transition risk linkages are more persistent. Linkage characteristics vary with industries' positions in the industrial structure and are moderated by climate policy. Disaster losses, management's climate perception and investor sentiment drive the observed heterogeneity. The RF model delivers the best prediction performance for risk contagion. In conclusion, there is a significant systemic association between China's climate risk indices and industry-level financial risks, and risk prevention efforts should focus on industry-level structural linkage features.

abstract: We analyze competition between two digital platforms selling subscriptions for unlimited access to their content catalogs. An upstream content provider offers additional content and chooses between a per-consumer wholesale price and a non-marginal contract, modeled as revenue sharing. The platforms independently decide whether to buy this additional content, so that exclusive or non-exclusive distribution arises endogenously. With low initial exclusivity, the content provider and both platforms prefer per-consumer wholesale pricing, yielding non-exclusive distribution and full consumer singlehoming. With high initial exclusivity, all parties prefer a non-marginal contract, yielding exclusive distribution and partial multihoming. Allowing contracts contingent on exclusivity does not change these predictions.
title: Channel Coordination on Exclusive vs. Non-Exclusive Content under Endogenous Consumer Homing
title_zh: 内生消费者归巢下独家与非独家内容的渠道协调

abstract: This study examines the relationship between geopolitical risk and energy poverty in 33 African net energy-importing economies from 2000 to 2023, focusing on fuel-import exposure, renewable energy, and institutional quality as vulnerability and resilience factors. Electricity poverty (ELP) is the primary outcome, while clean-cooking poverty (CCP) provides a complementary dimension of energy deprivation. The empirical strategy combines Panel Quantile ARDL-PMG with country-specific geopolitical risk, QCCEMG, Panel Fourier Toda-Yamamoto causality, conventional PMG-ARDL, and IV-based robustness checks. The results reveal a localized and specification-sensitive geopolitical-risk association. Global GPR is positively associated with ELP at the lower conditional quantile, but Wald tests do not support systematic cross-quantile heterogeneity, and the association disappears under QCCEMG. The lower-quantile association nevertheless remains visible under country-specific geopolitical risk and after excluding North African economies. Fuel-import exposure emerges as a structural vulnerability factor, particularly at higher electricity-poverty levels, while renewable energy provides only localized evidence of buffering geopolitical stress. QCCEMG further shows that renewable energy and institutional quality are associated with lower electricity deprivation at selected quantiles. Error-correction coefficients remain negative and highly significant across specifications, indicating stable adjustment toward long-run equilibrium. Complementary causality and IV results indicate that the geopolitical-risk relationship is more consistently detected for clean-cooking poverty than for electricity poverty. Overall, geopolitical risk appears to operate as an external stressor whose consequences depend on pre-existing structural vulnerabilities and conditional resilience capacity.
title: Geopolitical risk and energy poverty in African net energy importers: Localized effects, structural vulnerability, and conditional resilience
title_zh: 地缘政治风险与非洲净能源进口国的能源贫困：局部效应、结构性脆弱与条件性韧性

abstract: Nuclear energy development requires a legal framework that regulates risk and promotes the industry within one coherent design, yet the two objectives are commonly governed by separate bodies of law. In September 2025, China enacted the Atomic Energy Law (AEL), the first basic law to unify the statutory foundations of its nuclear energy activities. This article examines how the AEL constructs holistic nuclear governance, using an analytical framework comprising three components: systematization, comprehensiveness and balance. As a matter of legal design, the AEL consolidates norms previously dispersed across nuclear safety, security and non-proliferation, places instruments of risk regulation and industrial promotion in a single statute, and makes safety a binding precondition of development rather than a consideration within it. Effectiveness, however, does not follow from enactment: in each dimension the statutory achievement depends on subordinate rule-making and procedural design, from coordination between the independent safety regulator and the other departments charged with nuclear supervision to the operational content of promotional provisions and the terms of nuclear damage compensation. Therefore, for other nuclear states, the framework is a diagnostic instrument, not a template to be copied.

abstract: We study the patent system of the United Kingdom of the Netherlands (1815–30), a post‐Napoleonic state which brought together an early industrializing region that subsequently became Belgium with a later‐industrializing one comprising what is now the Netherlands. The system formally distinguished between patents of invention and patents of importation, protecting both domestic inventions and the introduction of foreign technologies. It also granted administrators considerable discretion over patent fees, terms, and conditions. Using a new hand‐collected dataset covering all patent applications, including those granted, withdrawn, and rejected, we analyse application outcomes across sectors, regions, and patent types. We show that administrators systematically differentiated between patents of invention and importation in ways consistent with a technology policy that encouraged the domestic introduction of useful foreign technologies. We also find that administrative decisions reflected assessments of novelty, utility, and applicant characteristics, without evidence of systematic discrimination. Despite high fees, the system remained broadly accessible across social classes. Patents of invention were more commonly associated with technically skilled inventors, whereas patents of importation were more often sought by commercially oriented applicants. Overall, the regime combined accessibility with substantive screening and illustrates how discretionary patent administration could support technology transfer during a formative period of industrialization.
abstract_zh: 我们研究荷兰联合王国（1815—30年）的专利制度。这一后拿破仑时代的国家将早期工业化、后来成为比利时的地区与后来工业化、构成今荷兰的地区结合在一起。该制度在形式上区分发明专利与引进专利，既保护国内发明，也保护外国技术的引入。它还在专利费、期限和条件方面赋予行政官员相当大的自由裁量权。利用一套新近手工收集、涵盖所有专利申请（包括已授予、撤回和驳回者）的数据集，我们分析了不同部门、地区和专利类型的申请结果。我们表明，行政官员对发明专利与引进专利进行系统性区分，其方式与鼓励在国内引入有用外国技术的技术政策相一致。我们还发现，行政决定反映了对新颖性、实用性和申请人特征的评估，没有系统性歧视的证据。尽管费用高昂，该制度在社会各阶层中仍大体可及。发明专利更常与具有技术技能的发明者相关联，而引进专利更常由具有商业取向的申请人寻求。总体而言，该制度将可及性与实质性审查结合起来，并说明在工业化的形成时期，自由裁量的专利管理如何能够支持技术转移。
title: Patently peculiar: Patents and innovation in the United Kingdom of the Netherlands
title_zh: 专利的独特性：尼德兰联合王国的专利与创新

abstract: Coal remains China's primary energy source and a fundamental commodity closely tied to economic stability and people's livelihoods. Reforming long-term contract pricing is therefore crucial for safeguarding energy security and supporting sustainable economic and social development. This study quantitatively examines how price subsidies in the coal market affect the allocation of input factors in production mines, with particular attention to nonlinear effects. With the objective of correcting factor market distortions in production mines, the study designs a reform of coal price subsidies and proposes a market-based range for long-term contract pricing. The main conclusions are as follows: (1) Reducing coal price subsidies helps mines optimize input factor allocation, improve production efficiency, and strengthen the foundation of energy security. (2) The effect of coal price subsidies on factor allocation efficiency in mines is nonlinear. It first declines and then rises as the mine period expense transfer rate increases, whereas it decreases as the cost–output value ratio rises. This pattern indicates a shift in input factor allocation from self-regulation toward stronger influence by non-market mechanisms. Moreover, as production costs increase, the distorting effect on resource allocation weakens because incentives for capacity expansion become limited. (3) The study identifies an estimated pricing interval based on the sample mines between 527.153 yuan/ton and 621.820 yuan/ton. From a policy perspective, the results suggest that the government should recognize the coal industry's role as a cornerstone of China's energy security and ensure that coal price subsidy design is closely aligned with the cost curves of actual mine production.
abstract_zh: 煤炭仍是中国的主要能源来源，也是与经济稳定和民生密切相关的根本性大宗商品。因此，改革长期合同定价对于保障能源安全、支撑经济社会可持续发展至关重要。本研究定量考察煤炭市场价格补贴如何影响生产矿井的投入要素配置，尤其关注非线性效应。研究以纠正生产矿井要素市场扭曲为目标，设计了煤炭价格补贴改革方案，并提出长期合同定价的市场化区间。主要结论如下：（1）降低煤炭价格补贴有助于矿井优化投入要素配置、提高生产效率并夯实能源安全基础。（2）煤炭价格补贴对矿井要素配置效率的影响呈非线性。随着矿井期间费用转移率上升，该效应先下降后上升；而随着成本产值率上升，该效应下降。这一模式表明投入要素配置由自我调节转向受非市场机制更强影响。此外，随着生产成本上升，对资源配置的扭曲效应减弱，因为产能扩张的激励变得有限。（3）研究基于样本矿井识别出估计定价区间为527.153元/吨至621.820元/吨。从政策角度看，结果表明政府应认识到煤炭行业作为中国能源安全基石的作用，并确保煤炭价格补贴设计与实际矿井生产的成本曲线紧密契合。

title: Coal subsidies and long-term contract pricing: a perspective from factor marketization reforms

abstract: Using data on more than 36,000 authors at 1000 business and economics departments, we study how the COVID-19 pandemic reshaped the distribution of research productivity. The pandemic widened pre-existing gaps: relative to the rest, output rose for top-50 departments and for senior and male scholars, while it fell for lower-ranked departments, women, and Ph.D. students. This widening is robust to restricting the sample to authors already active before the pandemic, to excluding scholars who changed institutions, and to using peer-reviewed publications rather than Social Sciences Research Network (SSRN) postings. Institutional slack appears to explain who absorbed the shock: larger departments, prior online-teaching experience, continued hiring, and closure policies matched to local severity are each associated with smaller losses. This episode illustrates how a common organizational shock can deepen inequality by favoring the already well-resourced.
abstract_zh: 利用1000个商业与经济系超过36000名作者的数据，我们研究了COVID-19大流行如何重塑了科研生产力的分布。疫情扩大了先前存在的差距：相对于其他群体，排名前50的系以及资深和男性学者的产出上升，而排名较低的系、女性和博士生的产出则下降。这一差距扩大在将样本限制为疫情前已活跃的作者、排除更换机构的学者，以及使用同行评审出版物而非社会科学研究网络（SSRN）发布时均保持稳健。机构冗余似乎解释了谁吸收了冲击：规模较大的系、此前的在线教学经验、持续招聘以及与当地严重程度相匹配的关闭政策，均与较小的损失相关。这一事件表明，共同的组织冲击如何通过偏向本已资源充足者而加深不平等。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 252
title: University shocks and research productivity inequality: Evidence from the COVID-19 pandemic
title_zh: 大学冲击与研究生产力不平等：来自COVID-19大流行的证据

abstract: We examine how the local food environment relates to health by shifting attention from the extensive margin (counts of food outlets) to the intensive margin, measured by the sales share of healthful retailers. Using a large national establishment dataset merged with tract-level health outcomes, we construct a sales-based healthfulness index of tract-level food environments and estimate its relationship with obesity, diabetes, high blood pressure, mental health issues, and depression of residents. We apply double/debiased machine learning with cross-fitting to flexibly adjust for high-dimensional socioeconomic and built-environment covariates and to separate intensive-margin access from overall retailer density. We find that higher healthful food-sales shares are positively associated with improved health outcomes; a 10-point increase in the healthful food sales share is associated with a 0.87 percentage-point lower obesity prevalence, a 0.19 percentage-point lower diabetes prevalence, and a 0.61 percentage-point lower high blood pressure prevalence, with similar improvements in mental health issues and depression. These associations are heterogeneous across baseline food environments: cardiometabolic outcomes respond most strongly in low-access tracts, while mental health improvements are larger in mid- and high access communities.
abstract_zh: 本文考察本地食品环境与健康之间的关系，并将关注点从外延边际（食品零售点数量）转向内涵边际，以健康食品零售商的销售份额来衡量。利用一个大型全国性商业机构数据集，并将其与普查区层面的健康结果数据合并，我们构建了普查区食品环境的基于销售额的健康度指数，并估计其与居民肥胖、糖尿病、高血压、心理健康问题和抑郁症之间的关系。我们采用双重/去偏机器学习并结合交叉拟合，以灵活调整高维社会经济和建成环境协变量，并将内涵边际可及性与零售商总体密度分离。我们发现，较高的健康食品销售份额与更好的健康结果呈正相关；健康食品销售份额每提高10个百分点，肥胖患病率降低0.87个百分点，糖尿病患病率降低0.19个百分点，高血压患病率降低0.61个百分点，心理健康问题和抑郁症也有类似改善。这些关联在基线食品环境之间存在异质性：心血管代谢结果在低可及性普查区反应最强，而心理健康改善在中、高可及性社区更大。
title: The intensive margin of food access and its association with health outcomes: evidence of heterogeneous effects across U.S. Communities
title_zh: 食物获取的集约边际及其与健康结果的关联：美国社区间异质性效应的证据

abstract: We propose computationally inexpensive and efficient estimators for multivariate stochastic volatility (MSV) models with cross-dependence, Granger causality, and higher-order persistence in latent volatilities. The proposed class of estimators is based on a small set of moment equations derived from the weak VARMA representations of MSV models. Except for the cross-dependence parameters, closed-form expressions are obtained for the remaining parameters, so that no numerical optimization is required. To improve the stability and efficiency of the volatility-persistence parameter estimates, we develop shrinkage-type VARMA estimators based on averaging different simple estimates (winsorization) and matrix-variate regressions (MVR). We also derive the asymptotic distribution of these estimators. Due to their computational simplicity, VARMA estimators make reliable — possibly exact — simulation-based inference tractable through Monte Carlo test techniques. We formulate volatility commonality as a testable common-C-space restriction on the MSV transition matrices, and develop finite-sample Monte Carlo tests for this hypothesis. Simulation results show that the proposed shrinkage-type VARMA-MVR estimators compare favorably with Bayesian and QML benchmarks in terms of bias, RMSE, and computational cost. They also remain feasible in very high dimensions, and, using auxiliary particle filtering, deliver accurate latent-state recovery and covariance forecasts even under model misspecification. In empirical applications to stock returns, we find that unrestricted higher-order MSV models perform well for covariance forecasting and portfolio building, while the data provide little support for an exact low-dimensional common dynamic subspace.
abstract_zh: 我们提出计算成本低且高效的多变量随机波动率（MSV）模型估计量，适用于具有交叉依赖、Granger因果性以及潜在波动率中高阶持续性的情形。所提出的估计量类别基于由MSV模型的弱VARMA表示导出的一小组矩方程。除交叉依赖参数外，其余参数均获得闭式表达式，因此无需数值优化。为提高波动率持续性参数估计的稳定性和效率，我们开发了收缩型VARMA估计量，其基于对不同简单估计进行平均（缩尾处理）以及矩阵变量回归（MVR）。我们还推导了这些估计量的渐近分布。由于其计算简便性，VARMA估计量使基于模拟的可靠——可能精确——推断通过蒙特卡罗检验技术变得可行。我们将波动率共性表述为MSV转移矩阵上可检验的共同C空间约束，并为该假设开发有限样本蒙特卡罗检验。模拟结果表明，所提出的收缩型VARMA-MVR估计量在偏差、RMSE和计算成本方面优于贝叶斯和QML基准。它们在极高维度下仍然可行，并且使用辅助粒子滤波，即使在模型误设下也能提供准确的潜在状态恢复和协方差预测。在股票收益的经验应用中，我们发现无约束的高阶MSV模型在协方差预测和投资组合构建方面表现良好，而数据对精确的低维共同动态子空间提供了很少支持。
title: Practical estimation methods for high-dimensional multivariate stochastic volatility models
title_zh: 高维多元随机波动率模型的实用估计方法

abstract: Societal shifts such as shrinking households and lower fertility, profoundly affect household consumption patterns and emissions, posing challenges to climate mitigation goals. Using Japan, one of the countries with smaller household size and fertility rate than the global average, as a reference, we investigate long-term carbon footprints from household consumption and its intertemporal gaps based on household size and structure, by using an environmentally extended input–output model and Japan's household consumption survey from 2012 to 2022. The findings reveal that per capita household carbon footprint decreases with increasing household size. However, even within households of the same size, per capita carbon footprint varies by household structure, with households having fewer children typically generating lower emissions. Moreover, the carbon footprints of households with children show a greater intertemporal reduction gap than those without children. This study emphasizes that carbon reduction policies should be formulated with a deep understanding of household characteristics under social shifts, and these results have broad applications in other nations undergoing demographic transitions.
abstract_zh: 家庭规模缩小和生育率下降等社会变迁深刻影响家庭消费模式与排放，对气候减缓目标构成挑战。本研究以日本为参照——该国是家庭规模和生育率均低于全球平均水平的国家之一——基于环境扩展投入产出模型和日本2012年至2022年家庭消费调查，考察家庭消费的长期碳足迹及其在家庭规模和结构上的跨期差距。研究发现，人均家庭碳足迹随家庭规模增大而降低。然而，即使在相同规模的家庭内部，人均碳足迹也因家庭结构而异，子女较少的家庭通常产生较低排放。此外，有子女家庭的碳足迹表现出比无子女家庭更大的跨期减排差距。本研究强调，碳减排政策应在深刻理解社会变迁下家庭特征的基础上制定，且这些结果在经历人口转变的其他国家具有广泛应用价值。
title: Uncovering household carbon emissions in a lower-fertility, shrinking society
title_zh: 揭示低生育率、萎缩社会中的家庭碳排放

abstract: This study develops an overlapping-generations New Keynesian model of housing bubbles that abstracts from financial frictions. A central finding is that housing bubbles and monetary policy jointly alter equilibrium determinacy and macroeconomic dynamics. Using E-stability as an equilibrium selection tool, we find a positive fundamental housing demand shock reduces consumption and raises inflation. By contrast, the effects of housing bubble shocks are regime-dependent. When the bubble is large and monetary policy is passive, bubble shocks can stimulate economic activity through wealth effects and endogenous monetary policy responses. When monetary policy is active, bubble shocks may instead reduce consumption, regardless of whether the bubble is small or large. The response reflects not only differences in monetary policy stance but also E-stability-based equilibrium selection. Finally, the dynamic effects of leaning against the wind policy vary sharply across regimes, amplifying or mitigating the macroeconomic impact of housing bubble shocks.
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个抽象掉金融摩擦的世代交叠新凯恩斯主义住房泡沫模型。核心发现是，住房泡沫与货币政策共同改变均衡确定性和宏观经济动态。以E-稳定性作为均衡选择工具，我们发现正向的基本面住房需求冲击会降低消费并推高通胀。相比之下，住房泡沫冲击的影响具有体制依赖性。当泡沫较大且货币政策被动时，泡沫冲击可通过财富效应和内生货币政策反应刺激经济活动。当货币政策主动时，无论泡沫是小还是大，泡沫冲击反而可能降低消费。这一反应不仅反映货币政策立场的差异，也反映基于E-稳定性的均衡选择。最后，逆风而行动政策的动态效应在不同体制下差异显著，或放大或缓解住房泡沫冲击的宏观经济影响。
title: Housing bubbles and monetary policy
title_zh: 住房泡沫与货币政策

abstract: This study examines how demographic ageing shapes global processed food trade by estimating trade‐income elasticities (IEs) that incorporate the influence of the aged population share, within a structural gravity model. The findings indicate that ageing amplifies IEs for processed food imports in both developed and developing economies while dampening them for domestic processed foods in developing economies. Import IEs in developed economies remain above unity, while those in developing economies are projected to rise from about 0.6 to nearly 1.3 in coming decades. Country‐ and product‐level estimates reveal substantial heterogeneity, with pronounced increases in import IEs for major economies and for processed meat, fish, fruit and vegetables, cocoa and sugar confectionery, and drinks. The contrasting responses of imported and domestically supplied processed foods may partly reflect differences in product composition. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for demographic ageing and product‐level heterogeneity when assessing future processed food trade.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过在一个结构引力模型中估计纳入老年人口占比影响的贸易收入弹性（IEs），考察人口老龄化如何塑造全球加工食品贸易。研究结果表明，老龄化会放大发达经济体和发展中经济体加工食品进口的收入弹性，同时抑制发展中经济体国内加工食品的收入弹性。发达经济体的进口收入弹性仍高于1，而发展中经济体的进口收入弹性预计在未来数十年内将从约0.6上升至接近1.3。国家层面和产品层面的估计显示出显著异质性，主要经济体以及加工肉类、鱼类、水果和蔬菜、可可和糖制糖果及饮料的进口收入弹性明显上升。进口加工食品与国内供给加工食品的相反反应可能部分反映了产品构成上的差异。这些发现凸显了在评估未来加工食品贸易时考虑人口老龄化和产品层面异质性的重要性。
title: Demographic Ageing and the Reshaping of Global Processed Food Trade
title_zh: 人口老龄化与全球加工食品贸易格局重塑

abstract: We exploit quasi-random interviewer assignment in the Australian HILDA Survey to instrument for self-reported drug use and estimate its effect on wages. Applying the optimal formula IV framework to six substance categories, we find that IV estimates largely mirror WLS for cannabis, ecstasy, and hallucinogens but diverge sharply for methamphetamine and inhalants — notably, the meth estimate reverses sign, indicating a wage penalty of 10% for frequent users, equivalent to the earnings loss from forgoing a high school diploma. Point estimates under IV suggest a larger premium for high cocaine use, but remain statistically similar to WLS. Romano-Wolf multiple-inference adjustment confirms substance-level significance for five of six drugs; the methamphetamine result, while just outside conventional thresholds after adjustment, is substantively large and clinically plausible. These findings demonstrate the empirical value of interviewer-driven variation for studying the labour-market effects of sensitive behaviours.
abstract_zh: 我们利用澳大利亚HILDA调查中访谈员分配的准随机性，作为自报药物使用的工具变量，并估计其对工资的影响。应用最优公式工具变量框架对六类物质进行分析，我们发现，对于大麻、摇头丸和致幻剂，工具变量估计与加权最小二乘估计基本一致，但对于甲基苯丙胺和吸入剂则出现显著分歧——值得注意的是，甲基苯丙胺的估计结果符号反转，表明频繁使用者面临10%的工资惩罚，相当于放弃高中文凭所带来的收入损失。工具变量下的点估计表明，高可卡因使用具有更大的溢价，但在统计上与加权最小二乘估计相似。Romano-Wolf多重推断调整确认了六种药物中五种在物质层面的显著性；甲基苯丙胺的结果在调整后虽略超出常规阈值，但实质上较大且在临床上是合理的。这些发现证明了访谈员驱动的变异对于研究敏感行为的劳动力市场效应具有实证价值。
title: Interviewers as instruments: estimating the wage penalty of drug use
title_zh: 面试官作为工具：估计吸毒的工资惩罚

abstract: We study whether concise fiscal information affects citizens’ stated willingness to pay taxes. We use a four-wave randomized survey experiment conducted in Spain during 2020–2021. Treated respondents received quantitative information on general government revenue as a share of GDP in Spain and selected comparator countries, presented in the survey as a broad indicator of the aggregate fiscal burden, together with a brief discussion of the trade-offs associated with taxation. The treatment increases stated willingness to pay higher taxes for improved public services and social benefits. The main ordered-logit estimate implies an increase of about 4.7 percentage points in the probability of expressing a positive willingness to pay more taxes. The result is robust to alternative codings of the outcome, alternative classifications of prior beliefs, and additional checks addressing interpretation and content specificity. We interpret the estimates as immediate stated responses to fiscal information, rather than as persistent changes in underlying preferences or behaviorally revealed willingness to pay.
abstract_zh: 我们研究简洁的财政信息是否会影响公民申报的纳税意愿。我们利用2020—2021年在西班牙开展的一项四轮随机调查实验。处理组受访者获得了关于西班牙及选定比较国家一般政府收入占GDP比重的定量信息，调查中将其作为总体财政负担的宽泛指标呈现，并附有关于税收相关权衡的简要讨论。该处理提高了受访者为改善公共服务和社会福利而申报愿意缴纳更高税收的意愿。主要的有序logit估计意味着，表达愿意缴纳更多税收的概率增加约4.7个百分点。该结果对结果的替代编码、先前信念的替代分类，以及针对解释性和内容特异性的额外检验均稳健。我们将这些估计解释为对财政信息的即时申报反应，而非底层偏好或行为揭示的支付意愿的持久变化。
title: Fiscal information and stated willingness to pay taxes: evidence from a survey experiment
title_zh: 财政信息与纳税意愿：来自调查实验的证据

abstract: Transboundary watersheds within China cross provincial, municipal, regional, and other subnational jurisdictions, separating ecosystem-service providers from beneficiary jurisdictions and creating persistent mismatches among ecological benefits, conservation responsibilities, and funding. This review examines how ecological compensation (EC) and payments for ecosystem services (PES) address these mismatches and develops a service-fund coupling framework. Following PRISMA 2020 reporting principles, it combines bibliometric analysis and metadata-based thematic synthesis of titles, abstracts, and keywords from 1263 studies published during 1995–2025 (823 China National Knowledge Infrastructure; 440 Web of Science) with a purposively stratified full-text audit and qualitative evidence synthesis of 60 studies. The literature has shifted from compensation standards, valuation, and institutional design toward ecosystem service flows, policy attribution, and actor interaction, but ecological, financial, behavioral, and institutional analyses remain weakly integrated. Five gaps persist: biophysical-economic translation, funding-behavior feedback, spatiotemporal mismatch, attribution and adaptive feedback, and equity and institutional constraints. The framework connects ecology-to-funding and funding-to-ecology chains through three interfaces: ecological evidence to payment responsibility, funding arrangements to behavioral additionality, and monitored outcomes to adaptive rule adjustment. It treats temporal lags, uncertainty, power asymmetries, and equity as internal coupling conditions, supporting adaptive, transparent, and accountable governance rather than static transfers. Because the evidence base is weighted toward Chinese-language EC research, the framework applies most directly to transboundary watersheds within China; international transboundary-basin research provides comparative and conceptual reference, and transfer beyond this intranational setting requires separate empirical testing.
abstract_zh: 中国境内的跨界流域跨越省、市、区域等次国家行政辖区，将生态系统服务提供者与受益辖区分隔开来，造成生态效益、保护责任与资金之间持续存在错配。本综述考察生态补偿（EC）与生态系统服务付费（PES）如何应对这些错配，并构建一个服务—资金耦合框架。遵循PRISMA 2020报告原则，本综述结合文献计量分析与基于元数据的主题综合，分析1995—2025年发表的1263项研究的标题、摘要和关键词（823项来自中国知网；440项来自Web of Science），并对60项研究进行有目的分层全文审查和定性证据综合。文献已从补偿标准、价值评估和制度设计转向生态系统服务流、政策归因和主体互动，但生态、财政、行为和制度分析仍整合不足。持续存在五个缺口：生物物理—经济转化、资金—行为反馈、时空错配、归因与适应性反馈，以及公平与制度约束。该框架通过三个接口连接生态到资金链与资金到生态链：生态证据到支付责任、资金安排到行为额外性、监测结果到适应性规则调整。它将时间滞后、不确定性、权力不对称和公平视为内部耦合条件，支持适应性、透明和可问责的治理，而非静态转移。由于证据基础偏重中文生态补偿研究，该框架最直接适用于中国境内的跨界流域；国际跨界流域研究提供比较和概念参考，超出这一国内情境的迁移需要单独的实证检验。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Service-fund coupling for ecological compensation and payments for ecosystem services in transboundary watersheds within China: A systematic review and conceptual framework
title_zh: 中国跨界流域生态补偿与生态系统服务付费的服务-资金耦合：系统综述与概念框架

abstract: Nominal interest rates increased significantly in the US and euro area following the post-pandemic inflation surge, yet economic activity and labour markets remained resilient. This column finds that accounting for policy expectations implies a larger increase in the natural rate of interest, r*, than standard approaches suggest. In the US, r* increased by around two percentage points and around 1.5 to 2 percentage points in the euro area. These increases are largely explained by changes in convenience yields. Thus, monetary policy stances were considerably less restrictive than commonly believed and this helps explain the soft landing in economic activity.
abstract_zh: 疫情后通胀飙升之后，美国和欧元区的名义利率显著上升，但经济活动和劳动力市场仍保持韧性。本专栏发现，考虑政策预期意味着自然利率r*的上升幅度大于标准方法所暗示的水平。在美国，r*上升了约两个百分点，欧元区上升了约1.5至2个百分点。这些上升在很大程度上可由便利收益的变化来解释。因此，货币政策立场比人们通常认为的限制性要小得多，这有助于解释经济活动的软着陆。
authors: Mátyás Farkas, Zoltan Jakab, Jesper Lindé
title: Historic monetary tightening, benign output dynamics: Rising R-stars across the Atlantic
title_zh: 历史性货币紧缩与良性产出动态：大西洋两岸R-star上升

abstract: Spending on public pensions through Social Security and on elderly healthcare through Medicare accounted for over one-third of federal expenditures in the US by 2024. This column explores how improvements in elderly health and life expectancy affected the relative finances of Social Security and Medicare. The elderly are not only living longer but also are in better health, so expected lifetime Medicare spending per elderly individual has grown much slower than expected lifetime Social Security spending. The authors analyse the forces that affect the optimal allocation of a given public budget across these two social insurance programmes.
abstract_zh: 到2024年，美国通过社会保障（Social Security）在公共养老金上的支出以及通过联邦医疗保险（Medicare）在老年人医疗保健上的支出，合计占联邦支出的三分之一以上。本专栏探讨老年人健康状况和预期寿命的改善如何影响社会保障和联邦医疗保险的相对财务状况。老年人不仅寿命更长，而且健康状况更好，因此每位老年人的预期终身联邦医疗保险支出增长远慢于预期终身社会保障支出。作者分析了影响在给定公共预算下这两个社会保险项目之间最优分配的因素。
title: Changes in the health and longevity of the elderly in the US
title_zh: 美国老年人健康与寿命的变化

abstract: Establishment parties are often urged to win voters over from populist parties by shifting their policy positions towards them. Based on the 2025 German federal election, this column simulates what would happen when the centre-right CDU changes its policies and the populist radical-right AfD responds. If the AfD stood still, a modest shift to the right would win the CDU a fifth of AfD voters, but the AfD would respond by moving further right, undoing the CDU’s gain. This strategy can thus leave the CDU worse off while pulling politics further to the right. Once the AfD's response is anticipated, moving right is no longer optimal for the CDU.
abstract_zh: 主流政党常被敦促通过将政策立场向民粹政党靠拢来争取其选民。基于2025年德国联邦选举，本专栏模拟了当中右翼基民盟改变其政策且民粹激进右翼选择党作出回应时会发生什么。如果选择党原地不动，温和右移将为基民盟赢得五分之一的选择党选民，但选择党会通过进一步右移来回应，从而抵消基民盟的收益。因此，这一策略可能使基民盟处境更糟，同时将政治进一步拉向右翼。一旦预期到选择党的回应，右移对基民盟而言就不再是最优选择。
title: Chasing far-right does not pay for the centre-right parties: Evidence from Germany’s 2025 election
title_zh: 中右翼政党追随极右翼得不偿失：来自德国2025年选举的证据
